news.balls.body.message:
Meet Celadon Reverie, Gilded Raku, Ink Bloom and Eclipse Velvet!

Each ball costs 10 gems to rent for one game entry, or 200 gems to own permanently.

Reset and play again within the same game at no extra cost. Returning to selection ends the rental; entering again requires a new rental. Rental payments do not reduce the ownership price. Ownership is saved on this device.
